name: Library Member
query:
SELECT
    `tabMember`.`member_name` as `Member Name:Link/Member:150`,
    `tabMember`.`membership_expiry_date` as `Membership Expiry Date:Date:150`,
    `tabMember`.`membership_type` as `Membership Type:Date:150`,
    `tabMember`.`email_id` as `Email_ID:Date:190`,
    `tabMember`.`pan_number` as `Pan Number:Data:150`
    FROM    
        `tabMember`
